method: Exact Ch1 crank, Ch2 fuel and autonomous opening fragments, optionally followed by complete production buddy update/claims/GOAP mechanically adapted to JavaScript. Geometry, threat and movement are controlled; selected fragment harness omits other mission work including order expiry, demo/config guards, and uses scheduler inactivity preconditions. No full mission/begin shader execution, WGSL compilation, f32 timing, natural gameplay or complete ordering-parity claim.
